description: This file defines the VerificationAtomsService class, which provides methods for email verification, secondary email management, and related operations within a NestJS application.

classes.name: VerificationAtomsService
classes.description: Service class providing email verification and secondary email management functionalities.

methods.name: checkEmailVerificationRequired
methods.description: Checks if email verification is required for the given input.

methods.name: verifyEmailCodeUnAuthenticated
methods.description: Verifies email code without user authentication, throws exceptions on failure.

methods.name: verifyEmailCodeAuthenticated
methods.description: Verifies email code with user authentication, throws exceptions on failure.

methods.name: sendEmailVerificationCode
methods.description: Sends a verification email with a code to the specified email address.

methods.name: getVerifiedEmails
methods.description: Retrieves verified emails for a user or team, removing client IDs from email addresses.

methods.name: addVerifiedEmail
methods.description: Adds a secondary verified email for a user, ensuring no duplicates.

methods.name: removeClientIdFromEmail
methods.description: Removes OAuth client ID segments from email addresses for normalization.
